# opnsense_monit_settings (Resource)

Monit general settings (**Services ▸ Monit ▸ Settings ▸ General**): polling, mail server for alerts, the Monit HTTP interface and M/Monit. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `monit_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_monit_settings.this
  id = "monit_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_monit_settings" "this" {
  enabled    = true
  interval   = 60
  mailserver = ["smtp.example.com"]
  port       = 587
  ssl        = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable monit.
- `eventqueue_path` (String) The path to the eventqueue directory.
- `eventqueue_slots` (Number) The number of eventqueue slots. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `httpd_allow` (Set of String) The username:password or host/network etc. for accessing the Monit httpd service.See Monit Authentication.
- `httpd_enabled` (Boolean) Start the Monit httpd service.
- `httpd_password` (String, Sensitive) Monit HTTPD Password.
- `httpd_port` (Number) Monit HTTPD Port. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `httpd_username` (String) Monit HTTPD Username.
- `interval` (Number) Polling interval in seconds. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `logfile` (String) The log file of the Monit process. This can be the keyword syslog or the path to a file.
- `mailserver` (Set of String) Comma-separated list of SMTP servers for alert delivery.
- `mmonit_register_credentials` (Boolean) Automatically register in M/Monit by sending Monit credentials (see Monit Access List above).
- `mmonit_timeout` (Number) M/Monit Timeout. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `mmonit_url` (String) The M/Monit URL.https://user:pass@192.168.1.10:8443/collectorIf you want to control Monit services from your M/Monit instance you have to configure the Monit Port too and add corresponding firewall rules as well.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password for mail server authentication.
- `port` (Number) The port of the mail server. Typically 465 for SSL or 25 for TLS and non secure connections. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `ssl` (Boolean) Enable encryption for mail server communication.
- `sslverify` (Boolean) Enable or disable SSL server certificate verification.
- `sslversion` (String) Set the SSL version to use. In AUTO mode, only TLS is used. One of `auto`, `tlsv1`, `tlsv11`, `tlsv12`, `tlsv13`.
- `startdelay` (Number) On system boot wait before Monit starts checking services. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `statefile` (String) The state file of the Monit process.
- `username` (String) The username for mail server authentication.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `monit_settings`.
